claims: Dunkin' Rewards members can get a free hot or iced coffee (any size) by entering the promo code STILLNOTAJOKE in the Dunkin' app on April 1, 2026.
The offer is for April Fools' Day 2026.
The offer is valid for one million coffees.
Once added, the reward is valid for seven days.
The offer is limited to one per customer.
The offer is specifically for Reward members.
